evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We build a multi-level long-horizon planning benchmark covering three representative industrial device panels, and evaluate the framework in simulation and real-world robotic experiments.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The framework generates parameterized action primitive sequences from task-relevant manual evidence and applies dual formal verification with LTL and a Safety FSM to enforce cross-step temporal correctness and local transition legality.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Results show that PanelShield improves complex safety-constrained task performance over foundation-model-only planning baselines while reducing the violation rate to 2.7%, with 4.1 s total latency.
